planets.name: HAT-P-54 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-54 with a 3.8-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: HAT-P-54 b was found in 2015 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-54. Its orbit and size follow Bakos et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
